title: Bernie Sanders: "Open borders? That's a Koch brothers proposal"
summary: A short clip of Bernie Sanders in conversation with Ezra Klein of Vox, where he rejects open borders as a proposal that serves the Koch brothers. It is an excerpt from a longer interview on global poverty.
why: HN commenters cite it in immigration debates as evidence of Sanders' 2015 position that open borders and high immigration hurt wages.

quote.text: Here's bernie sanders talking about how open boarders is pushed by the koch brothers to give them cheap labor
